core_meaning.primary_meaning: Slamet is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Safety, well-being”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Slamet corresponds to the Arabic form سْلَامِت (Arabic root س ل م (s-l-m); سَلَامَة (salāma)). Its core sense is slamet; safety, well-being (javanese form).
